name: @ferdousbhai/slop-detector
description: Deterministic linting for AI-flavored prose in browsers, repositories, and agent output

scripts.check: node --check bin/slop-detector.js && node --check lib/agent-hooks.js && node --check lib/install-hooks.js && node --check lib/linter.js && node --check lib/session-nudges.js && node --check extension/background.js && node --check extension/content.js && node --check extension/engine.js && node --check extension/popup.js && node --check extension/scanner.js && npm run check:versions
scripts.package:npm: npm run check:versions && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && npm pack --pack-destination dist
